up: Retrieve approved drugs (max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary) whose mechanism of action has action_type = 'POSITIVE MODULATOR' in the drug_mechanism table. Join with target_dictionary to include target information. Output columns: drug preferred name, drug ChEMBL ID, target preferred name, and target ChEMBL ID. Do not apply any row limits or sorting.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS drug_pref_name, md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM drug_mechanism dm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'POSITIVE MODULATOR'
